policy.scope: Expected model-only prediction throughput for the recorded recipe, not whole-pipeline speed or measured predictions per second.
policy.direction: High means higher expected throughput; Low means lower expected throughput.
policy.basis: Qualitative expert interpretation of documented inference mechanisms; documentation does not prescribe these category labels.
policy.assumptions: Ordinary CPU execution, moderate feature/class counts and representative point/label prediction. Batch size, implementation, hardware, fitted size and output choice can change the ordering.
policy.unknown: Unlisted or changed recipe configurations require review; no rating is guessed.
